title: Jefferson Barracks Family Day
description:
It was a beautiful September afternoon for the Jefferson Barracks annual family fun day. The Octoberfest themed day provided entertaining activities for hundreds of Missouri Air National guard members and their families. 

Children received an up close look at Riker the Eastern Screech Owl.  The World Bird Sanctuary brought an exhibit of four of their rescued birds including Riker and his Peregrine Falcon, Great Horned Owl, and Bald Eagle friends.
